name: Can my attorney file pretrial motions in a misdemeanor case?

mainEntity.name: Can my attorney file pretrial motions in a misdemeanor case?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Pretrial motions such as motions to dismiss, suppress evidence, or change venue can be filed to challenge the prosecution’s case before trial.sandiegocounty​
